generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have carried out repair /Rewinding /Reconditioning of Distribution transformers of 200KVA or above capacity in any industry/utility in India.In proof of the above, the bidder shall submit at least one copy of a Work Order and relevant work done Certificate for a work of value not less than Rs 4.65 lakhs executed in the last 5 financial years. Work orders of previous years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26) shall be escalated to the present price level by giving 10% weightage per year.

The bidder shall have an average annual financial turnover of Rs 9.30 lakhs in at least two years during last five financial years, (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26) (Financial turnover of previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level). In proof Annual Report/ turn over certificates/ profit and loss statement duly certified by Chartered accountant shall be furnished.
